MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 9

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 48

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
